claims.text: Azure SQL Server Accounts do not support Microsoft Entra ID authentication

For Entra ID auth the Azure SQL Server needs an Entra ID administrator granting access to the Veeam service account application
The Veeam service account application ID configured as Entra ID administrator
Authorizing VDC access to the Azure tenant requires Application Administrator role or higher in Entra ID
